run_depth_consistency_confidence: run the depth consistency confidence script to compute covisibility maps for scenes using argconf cli arguments
compute_covisibility_map: compute pairwise covisibility depth confidence maps for all frames in a scene and save as EXR files
process_frame: process a single frame to compute covisibility confidence by projecting depth points across overlapping views
review_process_frame_chunking: review the _process_frame function chunking logic that processes overlapping views in batches of 4000 to avoid OOM
refactor_depth_association_threshold: refactor the depth association threshold calculation in _process_frame to use a custom error formula
